newsitem.title: USA: Fluke names Katri chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: Fluke names Katri chief operating officer.

text.p: Fluke Corp Thursday named David Katri chief operating officer and executive vice president.

In a statement, the company also said George Winn, current chief operating officer and president, intends to retire in 1997. Winn will continue to serve as president until May 1, 1997, and will remain a member of the board.
